title: Slip Coding.pdf — page 17
text:
Incept and Expiry Dates
Inception and expiry dates are usually 
shown clearly on the first few pages of the 
slip.
If insurance is written as exactly 365 days 
(example: 01-Oct-2023 to 01-Oct-2024), 
change the expiry date to the previous day 
(30-Sep-2024).
Enter both dates in DD/MM/YYYY format in 
the INCEPTDATE and EXPIREDATE columns 
of the ACC file.
